problems.title: They come once and never return.
problems.text: There is nothing in place to bring a first-time customer back.

problems.title: No customer list.
problems.text: The apps keep the customer's details, so the business has nobody to contact.

problems.title: Up to 30% gone on every order.
problems.text: Delivery apps take 14% to 30%, which is £2.80 to £6.00 on a £20 order.

problems.title: No steady sales.
problems.text: UKHospitality forecast 2,076 venue closures in 2026, about six a day, with independents hit hardest.

problems.title: Social media done by hand, or not at all.
problems.text: Posting and replying take time nobody has during service.

usualFix: Delivery apps bring you orders, then take the margin and keep the customer. A basic ordering page takes orders but does nothing to bring anyone back. Bulk texts go to your whole list and most people ignore them. We join it up: orders come to you direct, every customer goes onto your own list, and the right people get a reason to come back.

faqs.q: Do we have to leave Deliveroo, Uber Eats or Just Eat?
faqs.a: No. Keep them for reaching new customers. We move your regulars to ordering direct, where you keep the margin.
